segments.title: Pre-Broadcast Systems Check & Lobby Configuration
segments.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell initializes Lethal Company session with extended lobby mods; Kendelle present in-studio; technical discussion of Thunderstore mod pipeline and coil-head/weeping-angel variant.

segments.title: First Quota Cycle — Titan & Experimental Moons
segments.notes: Crew completes initial scrap runs on Titan; learns nutcracker and coil-head threat patterns; secures first 1,000-credit quota; discovers shower apparatus and radiation mechanics.

segments.title: Mid-Session Quota Push — High-Value Recovery & Freestyle Derailment
segments.notes: Blackwell attempts freestyle rap during scavenging; crew hits 1,700+ credits; experiments with inverse teleporter and radar boosters; multiple coil-head wipes on eclipsed moons.

segments.title: Eclipse Moon Gauntlet & Personal Logistics Sidebar
segments.notes: Blackwell discusses upcoming relocation, office couch acquisition, and brother's prospective PC build during downtime; crew survives bracken/jack-in-the-box gauntlet; peaks at 2,231 credits.

segments.title: Final Inverse-Teleport YOLO Run & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Full crew inverse-teleports into flooded Dine moon; rapid wipe; Blackwell raids Radium V with tomb-looting directive; confirms return to news format tomorrow.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored three-hour Lethal Company marathon from newsroom desk; managed lobby mods, quota strategy, and freestyle interludes.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Co-piloted scavenging runs via Discord; managed teleporter recalls; provided in-studio commentary and scream alerts.

lore_notes.fact: Confirmed impending relocation; new streaming office will accommodate a couch; brother may acquire PC for co-op play.
States intent to resume standard news broadcast format tomorrow after extended Lethal Company hiatus.
Gifted Blackwell a foot massager for Christmas; operates as in-studio co-pilot during extended gaming broadcasts.

episode_summary: Anchor Case Blackwell suspended standard news operations for an extended Lethal Company session, fielding a rotating crew of remote operatives and in-studio contributor Kendelle across multiple quota cycles. The broadcast peaked at 2,231 credits before a final inverse-teleport yolo run on a flooded eclipse moon resulted in total crew wipe. Blackwell confirmed return to news desk tomorrow and disclosed impending studio relocation.
